name: secure-app
description: App-layer security for your builds: ASVS-lite checks (credentialed CORS, stack traces in responses, debug routes, sign-out that only clears the browser, object writes without an ownership reference), outbound-fetch guard against SSRF, abuse and spend (uncapped paid APIs, unset caps that mean unlimited, open proxies, per-client ceilings, caller-set LLM params), auth gates that open on their own (a guard skipped when a secret is unset, identity from a bare header, Access trusted only at the edge, open better-auth sign-up), AI route metering (a daily counter reserved before every paid call, with a drop-in guard template), authorization inside MCP tools (every tool-reachable query scoped to the signed-in identity, no identity from tool arguments, privileged tools gated), and tests proven by removing each protection. Requires secure-core.
